title: EXOTIC-CCR A001: Poisson/Weyl lifts and Lean-backed dual-transport deficiency theory
description: Proposed, untagged A001 scientific-revision candidate. The revised paper states Hilbert deficiency indices n_+=n_-=aleph0 for the canonical H=-iX1, using the forward maximal sheet and sign-involution transport in the main proof. The synchronized Lean publication freeze is b8bc72ea87531b88d50ed588ec6268ae743a662f; it is untagged and unreleased. The historical theorem-source root is ff50f4a2a312591c2e5b26e71eb390ade9164b34. Lean proves an injective family of distinct self-adjoint-extension witnesses parameterized by unitary complex phases, exhibiting a continuum-sized lower family without identifying the exact cardinality of the full extension type. Math.FA, math.AG, Lean/build, non-claims, and package/metadata gates pass; only Dan approval remains pending. No preferred extension, arbitrary-operator theorem, exact Hamel rank, strong CCR, physical selection, or rank-three Dixmier counterexample is claimed.
